from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A document in the collection containing its own title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this document cites in its text or bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
